strings.Settings.Tab1.Title: Jellyfin Server Connection & Authentication
strings.Settings.Tab1.ApiKeyToolTip: Key created in Jellyfin Dashboard -> Advanced -> API Keys
strings.Settings.Tab1.ApiKeyInfo: Primary recommended method: In your Jellyfin Dashboard, go to Advanced -> API Keys, generate a new key, and enter it here. Unlike password sessions, it does not expire, is stored encrypted in Windows Credential Manager, and is sent solely in the Authorization: MediaBrowser header.
strings.Settings.Tab2.Title: Select Libraries and Media Types
strings.Settings.Tab2.SignInToLoadItems: Connect to a Jellyfin server first to load titles.
strings.Settings.Tab2.SelectMovieOrSeries: Select at least one media type (Movies or Series).
strings.Settings.Tab3.Title: Timing, Playback Order & Desktop Wallpaper Behavior
strings.Settings.Tab3.ApplyToWallpaper: Automatically apply slideshow images as Windows desktop wallpaper
strings.Settings.Tab3.RestoreOnExit: Restore original Windows wallpaper when exiting the app
strings.Settings.Tab4.Title: Desktop Clickable Icon Mode for Opening Jellyfin
strings.Settings.Tab4.ShortcutNote: In 'Standard Desktop Shortcut' mode, a real Windows shortcut is placed among your desktop icons so you can position it freely and double-click to open the currently displayed movie or series.
strings.Settings.Tab4.OverlayNote: Changes apply immediately and floating coordinates are clamped within active monitor bounds.
strings.Settings.Tab5.Title: Where to Open a Title When Clicking the Desktop Icon
strings.Settings.Tab5.DesktopClientNote: Note: In 'Jellyfin Desktop App' mode, the app sends the item via the official Jellyfin Sessions remote-control API. If the desktop client is not installed or active, a browser fallback prompt is offered.
strings.Settings.Tab6.Title: Local Cache Management, Backdrop Selection & Fallback Image
strings.Settings.Tab6.RandomBackdrop: Pick a random backdrop per title
strings.Settings.Tab6.FilterAspectRatios: Automatically filter ultra-wide banners, square, and portrait images
strings.Settings.Tab6.AspectFilterNote: The recommended preset keeps standard widescreen wallpapers (16:9, 16:10, 21:9) while skipping narrow banners, square artwork, and vertical posters. Other backdrops on the same item are checked automatically before skipping.
strings.Settings.Tab7.Title: Interface Language, Layout Direction & Startup Behavior
strings.Settings.Tab7.LanguageHint: Switching the language immediately adapts the entire interface between Right-to-Left (RTL) and Left-to-Right (LTR). Additional languages can be added modularly by placing JSON language packs in the languages folder.
strings.Settings.Tab7.StartupCheck: Launch automatically at Windows sign-in (Current User Run)
strings.Settings.Tab7.StartMinimizedCheck: Start minimized in the System Tray
strings.Settings.Tab7.MinimizeOnCloseCheck: Keep running in the System Tray when main window closes
strings.Settings.Tab7.StorageInfo: Settings are saved atomically to %LOCALAPPDATA%\JellyfinDesktopSlideshow\settings.json, while API keys and session tokens are stored only in Windows Credential Manager.
strings.Settings.Tab8.Title: Clean Image Cache, Settings, Hidden State Files & App Footprints
strings.Settings.Tab8.Description: Inspect and delete cached images, logs, hidden state files, desktop icon artifacts, and stored credentials to remove every footprint left by the application.
strings.Settings.Tab8.FootprintHeader: Current application footprint on this PC:
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptImageCache: Clear cached backdrop images and converted wallpaper staging files (cache)
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptLogsAndHidden: Clear logs, hidden state files, and shortcut icon cache (logs, current-wallpaper-item.json, icons, *.tmp)
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptCredentials: Remove active session & saved API key/token from Windows Credential Manager
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptOsTraces: Remove OS traces (Windows Startup registry entry, desktop shortcut, wallpaper backup/state, hide overlay)
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptRestoreWallpaper: Restore original Windows wallpaper before deleting backup/state files
strings.Settings.Tab8.OptResetSettings: Delete settings.json completely and reset settings in memory
strings.Settings.Tab8.FullWipeWarning: Warning: 'Full Reset & Remove All Traces' permanently deletes all cached images, settings and hidden state files, logs, stored API keys/tokens, desktop shortcut, startup registry entry, and the local app data directory.
strings.Settings.Tab8.ConfirmFullWipeMessage: Are you sure you want to delete all cached images, settings, hidden state files, logs, stored credentials, and OS traces of this app?
